summary.headline: Zodiacal Signs and Degrees
summary.text: Florentine codex material on the natures of the planets and the twelve zodiacal signs, followed by the sixty-five terms/degrees and their effects in nativities, masculine and feminine degrees, and references to the Venetian catalogue and appendix.
